name: scen-space-auth-email-server-kit
description: Cumulative Scen server kit with DB-backed auth, Google OIDC, transactional email, payments, media gateways, storage and Vercel connector
notes: DATABASE_URL and object-storage credentials are server-only.
All project/scene/asset repository reads are scoped by workspaceId from the signed user session.
Direct uploads use HMAC-bound completion tokens plus presigned private object URLs.
Generated image/video bytes are ingested through the same storage adapter.
Checkout creation is server-only and uses provider idempotency where supported.
Browser redirects never mutate credits; verified webhook processing does.
Credit wallet reservations are workspace-scoped and transactionally locked.
Manual credit adjustments require Owner role and an audit reason.
User sessions are opaque random tokens; only SHA-256 hashes are stored in PostgreSQL.
Protected user routes check session revocation in the database.
Google sign-in uses Authorization Code + PKCE + state binding.
Verification/reset/invitation tokens are single-use and stored hashed.
Transactional email provider keys are server-only; Resend/Postmark adapters are available.
